investigations.summary: PMM-T2004 failed 3/3 on all 7 docker runs: the nightly server sets PMM_DATA_RETENTION=48h, so restoreSettingsDefaults got a 400 ('Data retention for queries is set via PMM_DATA_RETENTION') after dropping telemetry; reproduced on a VM with the same image and env, fixed by dropping whichever env-pinned field the 400 names.

All 18 Upgrade AMD lanes: #1432 deleted support_scripts/check_client_upgrade.py, which pmm3-upgrade-test-runner still runs in its Check Client before/after Upgrade stages (python3 exits 2 on the missing file; reproduced). Restored unchanged; Jenkins consoles were unreadable (403), so attribution is from the pipeline source.

nightly / ha: same failure set as nightly 54 (PMM-T2298/T300/T2039/T418/T1988/T506/T878, empty Node Summary, PMM Health and VictoriaMetrics panels), all in one shard; HA-specific, an HA cluster repro was not attempted. gssapi and ami 3.8.0 are Jenkins-only and their consoles returned 403, so they were not diagnosed.
